gaps.explanation: Detail records the p4 governmental funds statement 'Transfers in(out)' row gross per fund: General (333,276) out, and Capital Projects 51,058 + Fire/Rescue 19,715 + Cemetery 1,827 + Pool, Park Auditorium 55,708 + Non major Funds 52,775 = 181,083 in. The Total column prints the net (152,193) (to Water/Sewer, p6 Transfers in (out) 152,193). 333,276 - 181,083 = 152,193; the gap of -181,083 is exactly the intra-governmental transfers in. The Pass-through grant in/out 71,511 net to 0. Gross vs net only; no error. (Side note: the five positive transfer lines and the Water/Sewer p10 line +152,193 carry the label 'Transfers Out' in detail, but they are transfers in as printed.)

The statement total is 362,392 = p6 Operating revenue 336,654 (accrual) + Insurance proceeds 25,738. The detail is the p10 cash-basis budget schedule Receipts 'Water and sewer' 323,508 (= p7 Cash received from customers). The schedule prints Insurance reimbursement 25,738 under Other Financing Sources (in detail as section 'other financing'). Gap 38,884 = 25,738 (insurance classified as other financing on p10) + 13,146 (accrual vs cash: 336,654 - 323,508; p8 reconciliation: increase in accounts receivable (7,459), decrease in customer deposits (4,688), etc.). Both printed amounts are correct on their own basis.

The statement total 542,965 (p2) = p6 Total operating expenses 452,264 (incl. Depreciation 81,185) + Interest expense 25,701 + Debt payment 65,000. The p10 cash budget schedule prints Total 459,726 = Water and Sewer 369,025 (= p7 cash paid 387 + 368,638) + Principal 65,000 + Interest 25,701. Gap 83,239 = 452,264 - 369,025 = depreciation 81,185 + 2,054 (accrued operating costs not yet paid). Different basis.
